TIL that in 1881, Fanny Hesse suggested growing bacteria on agar, a jelly ingredient from her own kitchen, because the gelatin in her husband's experiments kept melting in the summer heat. Agar is still the standard in labs worldwide, and she never got credit for the idea.

TIL sleeping in a cold room is better for you as your core temperature needs to drop to signal to the brain and body that it's time to go to sleep. This lower temperature has been found to help people fall asleep faster and sleep more deeply.

TIL in 1982, 19 year old UT student Gregory Watson wrote a paper about how a 1789 Amendment to the Constitution was never ratified. The TA and professor gave him a C Grade. He campaigned for it and in 1992 the amendment was ratified. 35 years later his C was changed to an A.

TIL that Rowan Atkinson once received a record high car insurance payment of £910000. In 2011 he was involved in a serious crash after loosing control of his rare McLaren F1 and colliding with a tree.

TIL Extremal Black Holes have the absolute minimum mass allowed for their charge or spin. This drops their temperature to absolute zero, meaning they emit zero Hawking radiation and could theoretically last forever—making them immortal objects that bypass standard black hole death.

TIL the Tuatara is a reptile native to New Zealand that evolved to have 3 eyes and can live in temperatures as low as 41°F (5°C). Despite its close resemblance to lizards, they in fact are not lizards. Instead being the only living member of the Rhynchocephalia lineage
TIL that there is a fruit in Indonesia that is poisonous. In order for it to be edible, the fruits have to be boiled and fermented in ash for about 40 days, in which the hydrogen cyanide is removed.
TIL that Uranus rotates on its side at an axial tilt of nearly 98 degrees, causing each of its poles to experience 42 years of continuous sunlight followed by 42 years of darkness.

TIL that Lycia Naff who briefly appeared in 1990 movie Total Recall as a three-breasted sex worker subsequently received a flood of media inquiries and invitations to talk shows including from Johnny Carson. She turned them all down and regretted it afterwards.
TIL that in 2019, a Canadian woman scared off a cougar approaching her and her dog by playing Metallica's “Don’t Tread on Me” on her cellphone after shouting failed to deter it.
